data.gender_notes: Mahsa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'mah' which means 'tender' or 'delicate', Mahsa is a beautiful female name in Islamic culture symbolizing compassion and sensitivity. The name Mahsa carries the meaning “Tender-hearted, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahsa usually hope their child will grow to embody tender-hearted, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahsa total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

It is a name that evokes tenderness, delicacy, and the ideal of compassion. There are several famous figures, tales, and literary works that carry this name, further enhancing its popularity and significance.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mahsa represents a loving, caring, and nurturing individual. Its meaning embodies the essence of compassion, a virtue highly esteemed in Islamic teachings. It is a reminder of the importance of showing kindness, empathy, and understanding towards others, as Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) once said, "Whoever relieves a believer of some sorrow, Allah will relieve him of some of his sorrows on the Day of Judgment." In this way, the spiritual significance of the name Mahsa resonates with the core values and principles of Islam.
